beats.text: 1995. The night before his train to Delhi, he borrowed one book. He never returned it.
That book got him through hostel, two failed exams and his first job.
Today he came back to pay. The librarian, now 74, didn't take his money.
She stamped the book RETURNED, and slid a new card across. "Next one's due in two weeks."
beats.small: Some teachers don't stand in classrooms.

end.text: Which book would you never give back?

caption:
31 years late. Rs 4,380 in fines. And a librarian who wouldn't take a rupee. 📚
